headline: Linn Mercy Costliest; Palantine Berm Ledger Shifts to Colonials
war_summary: Palantine Berm leads the change since the last edition: the ledger there now reads five Colonial works against two Warden and none unclaimed, where the earlier report found four Colonial, two Warden and one held by neither. Thirteen events fell there in six hours before the front went quiet in the latest two. Linn Mercy remains the costliest and busiest ground, five events in the past two hours and nine in six, chiefly about Outwich Ranch; the hex holds nine Colonial works, one Warden and one unclaimed, with roughly twelve hundred Warden and eight hundred Colonial casualties an hour, both cooling from the hour before. Mooring County, all twelve works Warden, logged three events in two hours at MacConmara Barrows after a heavy day. Weathered Expanse, heaviest of the twenty-four hours at forty-six events across seven Warden works and two unclaimed, has filed nothing since late evening. Nevish Line counted three events in six hours at Grief Mother; Marban Hollow twenty in the day. Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle and Kuura Strand also stirred. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
